verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The Indian government has not announced any 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026'. Official sources have confirmed that messages promoting such a scheme are fake and part of a scam to collect personal information.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple official and media sources have debunked the claim of a 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026'. The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check and the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) have both issued statements clarifying that no such scheme exists and that these viral messages are fraudulent attempts to collect personal data. This is a recurring scam, with similar false claims being debunked in previous years as well.
